title: docs: three pages list currencyConfig without homeAmount (field-types, validation-rules, objectql schema)
body:
domain:skills#2 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1QkPVVzNz3FJqb2iS

Filing gate ①: a follow-up owed by in-flight work. It comes from the contract review of PR #28323 (#28203), should-fix 2. Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2 (#19287). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade and no lane: triage sets both (the pages are `content/docs`).

**Business reason.** PR #28096 (#27191) shipped `currencyConfig.homeAmount`, and PR #28323 teaches it in the skill. Three hand-written docs pages still list `currencyConfig` with only its older keys, so a reader of those pages never learns the home-currency projection exists.

**Reader who acts:** the owner of `content/docs` prose (devx), or whoever lands beside draft PR #28302's `currency.mdx` rewrite.

## Measured (`origin/main` at the PR #28323 review, 2026-10-31)

`CurrencyConfigSchema` is a closed object with exactly `currencyMode`, `defaultCurrency`, `currencyField` and `homeAmount`. These pages list the keys without `homeAmount`:
- `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx` ~:228-230
- `content/docs/data-modeling/validation-rules.mdx` ~:155-157 and ~:537
- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/schema.mdx` ~:295

Draft PR #28302 rewrites only `currency.mdx`. Its new `rateDate` row says "a `date` or `datetime` field", which agrees with the skill.

## Wanted

Name all four keys on each page, with `homeAmount` pointing at `currency.mdx` for its shape (`field`, `rateDate` as `date`/`datetime`, `rateField` as `number`).

Links: #27191, PR #28096, PR #28323, PR #28302.
